title.purpose: Service names on cards — the only emphasized text.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Flat doctrine: depth is contrast + 1px hairlines. LED 8px halo is instrument light, not shadow.

motion.name: led-blink
motion.purpose: Drag escalation: warn LED blink on the dragged module only.

motion.name: dim-patch
motion.value: 0.4 opacity on non-dragged cells while patching

components.name: Status Block
components.description: LED + service name + mono host; the signature component.
components.html: Home Assistantha.local:8123
components.css: .ds-noc-card { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px; background:var(--surface,#12151a); border:1px solid var(--surface-border,#23282e); border-radius:6px; text-decoration:none; color:var(--text,#e8ecef); transition: border-color .2s ease; } .ds-noc-card:hover { border-color: var(--hairline-strong,#3a414a); } .ds-led { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; flex:none; } .ds-led-up { background:#2ee6a8; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(46,230,168,.55); } .ds-body { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; min-width:0; flex:1; } .ds-body .ds-name { font: 600 18px/1.15 system-ui, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-host { font: 400 11.5px 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-dim,#8b949e); }

components.name: Telemetry Header
components.description: Full-width strip: big mono clock, date/temp/theme right.
components.css: .ds-noc-hdr { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 24px; padding:28px 32px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline,#23282e); background:var(--bg,#0b0e11); } .ds-noc-hdr .ds-clock { font: 600 clamp(32px,4.5vw,56px)/1 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing:-0.02em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--text,#e8ecef); } .ds-side { display:flex; gap:20px; color:var(--text-dim,#8b949e); font: 400 13px system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Widget Block
components.description: Caps label always on top, large tabular content.
components.css: .ds-widget { display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; gap:6px; padding:14px 18px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--surface,#12151a); border:1px solid var(--surface-border,#23282e); border-radius:6px; } .ds-wlabel { flex:none; font: 500 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--text-dim,#8b949e); } .ds-wclock { font: 600 40px/1 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color:var(--text,#e8ecef); }

components.name: Edit Toolbar
components.description: Flat full-width maintenance strip with caps text buttons.
components.css: .ds-tb { display:flex; background:rgba(11,14,17,.88); border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline,#23282e); } .ds-tb button { border:none; border-left:1px solid var(--hairline,#23282e); background:transparent; color:var(--text-dim,#8b949e); padding:6px 14px; font:500 12px system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tb button:hover { color:var(--text,#e8ecef); }

narrative.overview: Дашборд — стена мониторинга сетевого центра: матовый почти-чёрный грунт, плоские блоки, волосяные линии. Статус сервисов — главная типографика; телеметрия по краям. Глубина из контраста; движение — только ответ на действие.
keyCharacteristics: Label tier 11px caps vs content tier

rules.name: The Instrument Rule
rules.body: Любая цифра — monospace tabular; пропорциональные цифры в телеметрии — ошибка.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Тени нет; глубина = контраст + 1px hairlines; LED-halo — свет прибора, не тень.
